verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents that agents store conversation transcripts and audio recordings, with configurable retention (default 2 years). It also documents an ElevenLabs API and conversation search, so recording and storage of every call are first-party features. No evidence shows an API endpoint that actually returns recordings or transcripts. missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for listing conversations and fetching transcripts and audio, proof that retrieval covers every call, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call

citations.quote: Retention settings allow you to configure how long your conversational agent stores conversation transcripts and audio recordings.
By default, ElevenLabs retains conversation data for 2 years.
ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
Searching conversations: Find messages by keyword or meaning across your conversation history.
